main_body: wooden coop/hut on stilts with a sloped plank roof
top_band: sloped wooden plank roof in warm tan/brown from row 1 to row 20 (ridge highlight at row 1, planks rows 2-18, eave trim rows 19-20)
evidence: Rows 1-20 form the visible top slope of the wooden roof (ridge highlight at row 1, planks down to the front eave trim at rows 19-20). Row 21 is the dark eave overhang line, row 22 has an eave shadow on the recessed front wall (rows 22-34), followed by a protruding floor ledge (rows 35-36) and stilts/ramp down to row 43.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference buildings, the candidate uses flat vertical bands of solid brown for both roof planks and wall boards with no wood grain, speckle, or per-tile highlight variation. Heavy near-black outlines surround the roof, wall, door opening, and window box, giving a blocky, low-density look.
